description: Header file defining the FrameRateImplementation class, which implements frame rate control and notification functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin, including event handling, interface registration, and FPS collection.

classes.name: FrameRateImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IFrameRate interface and handles video device events related to display framerate changes, FPS collection, and event notifications within the plugin.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within FrameRateImplementation that encapsulates a dispatch job for handling display framerate change events asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for frame rate events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Retrieves the current display frame rate.

methods.name: SetCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets the frequency for FPS collection.

methods.name: OnDisplayFrameratePreChange
methods.description: Callback for pre-change display framerate event.

methods.name: OnDisplayFrameratePostChange
methods.description: Callback for post-change display framerate event.
